settings.label: Prefer Hi-Res
settings.help: When the app's quality is Lossless, ask for Hi-Res first. Type true or false if your app shows a text field.

settings.label: Mainland IP
settings.help: Outside mainland China, NetEase won't play many songs. A mainland Chinese IP address here, such as 116.25.146.177, makes requests look like they come from there. Leave blank otherwise.
